sources.finding: When .ir.sig is absent, the pinned loader returns an empty optional IR array. Existing olean files are still imported.
Olean extension entries preserve the meta closure and public signatures as extern declarations; interpreter declaration lookup falls back from optional IR entries to these olean entries.
For a non-module import environment, initialization tries the native all-phases module initializer and returns immediately if it succeeds.
Native symbol dispatch still requires a declaration signature; the olean fallback supplies public signatures. Native module initialization directly resolves and calls its exported native initializer.

assessment: Evidence supports a reversible archive of only the listed core IR pairs while retaining every olean part and native binary unchanged. This does not remove kernel declarations or proofs. Native initializers cover the entire core module set; ordinary public/native and meta calls have olean metadata fallbacks.
compatibility_limit: This is not a claim that every possible private runtime import-all call is covered by olean fallbacks. Any missing execution metadata should fail with an interpreter error; the unchanged official checker must establish compatibility.
retain: all native core binaries and shared libraries
Lake,LeanIR,LeanExport optional IR unless separately assessed
mutations_by_auditor: None to toolchain, libraries, checker, proof or configuration; only this report and source/coverage records in task scratch.
